purpose: Index of documents in docs/ for every agent to consult before reading or writing docs.

entries.title: Documentation index
entries.description: Index of Markdown documents in docs/. Find documents by title, description and tags; open the detail file via path when its content fits the request.

entries.title: Compact all rules and move details into skills
entries.description: Repository testcases for thin rules, semantic owners, references and runtime configuration after the refactor; use for agent configuration regression.

entries.title: Debug rule/skill, compact Token line and context-threshold remind-cleanup
entries.description: Repository testcases for the bug-fix rule, debugs skill, compact Token line with total and the remind-cleanup hook at the 80% context threshold; use for agent/hook configuration regression.

entries.title: Codex handoff - CLI for Claude coding token usage stats
entries.description: Handoff to Codex to build the lumina-agent usage command, reading Claude Code transcripts and logs.jsonl to report token usage by session, turn, subagent and day; use when implementing or reviewing the token CLI.

entries.title: Optimize rules and review repo structure
entries.description: Repository testcases verifying rules consolidated to a single owner, no lost constraints, live anchors and unchanged symlinks/paths; use for agent configuration regression.

entry_schema.path: File path relative to the repository root; used to open the source file.
entry_schema.tags: Array of short lowercase keywords, kebab-case preferred; choose by topic, document type and related technology.
entry_schema.description: Short description helping AI decide whether to open the detail file.
entry_schema.detail_file: Detail Markdown file with title, description, tags in frontmatter and full content in the body.

update_policy.before_read_or_write: Every agent must read the index and find documents by title, description or tags; open path to read the detail file before editing.
update_policy.after_write: Every time a Markdown document in docs/ is created or edited, update title, description, tags and path in the same turn.
update_policy.after_structure_change: Update or delete the entry when a file in docs/ is renamed or deleted.
update_policy.avoid_duplication: Prefer editing the existing detail file; create a new file only when no suitable entry exists.
